requirement: This code should implement a heat exchange calculation within a FUNCTION_BLOCK named HeatExchanger2, where it calculates the new room temperature based on the input heat, thermal conductance, thermal capacity, initial room temperature, and outside temperature, updating every sample time. The inputs include Heat_In (heat source in watts), U (thermal conductance in watts per kelvin), TC (thermal capacity in joules per kelvin), Temp_In (initial room temperature in kelvin), Temp_Out (outside temperature in kelvin), and Sample_time (time interval for updates). The output is Temp, representing the new room temperature in kelvin. The function should only update Temp if the current time minus the last update time exceeds Sample_time. It calculates the heat flow as the input heat minus the product of thermal conductance and the temperature difference between the last recorded temperature and the outside temperature. The new temperature is then calculated by adding the product of the heat flow, the time interval in seconds (converted from Sample_time), and the reciprocal of the thermal capacity to the last recorded temperature. The function should handle the initialization case where the last update time is zero by setting the last recorded temperature to the initial room temperature.
requirement_cn: 此代码应实现一个名为 HeatExchanger2 的功能块，用于根据输入的热量、热传导率、热容量、初始室内温度和外部温度计算新的室内温度，并在每个样本时间更新。输入包括 Heat_In（热源，单位为瓦特）、U（热传导率，单位为瓦特/开尔文）、TC（热容量，单位为焦耳/开尔文）、Temp_In（初始室内温度，单位为开尔文）、Temp_Out（外部温度，单位为开尔文）和 Sample_time（更新间隔时间）。输出为 Temp，代表新的室内温度，单位为开尔文。该函数应仅在当前时间与上次更新时间之差超过 Sample_time 时更新 Temp。它计算热流量为输入热量减去热传导率与上次记录温度与外部温度之差的乘积。然后通过将热流量、时间间隔（以秒为单位，从 Sample_time 转换得来）与热容量的倒数的乘积加到上次记录的温度上来计算新温度。该函数应处理初始化情况，即上次更新时间为零时，将上次记录的温度设置为初始室内温度。
